fusions.name: Unhurried Rollover
fusions.desc: Rolls your whole body over, dealing 30 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Soaked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Delayed Nudge
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: sends a slow, heavy swell that deals 18 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Nothing Is Urgent
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 6 tiles in place for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Mending Tide
fusions.desc: When you regain health, the healing you receive rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
